TermTranslation.definition: A small growth on the lining of an organ or body part, such as the colon, bladder, uterus, vocal cords or nose.

TermTranslation.term: â apishinihtâuchihch châkwân pîhtiwiyâhch, muyâm anitâh chitichishîhch, chiwîyuhch, uspâhch, chikuhtâkinâpîhch kiyâh mâk chiskutihch)
TermTranslation.term_syllabics: ᐋ ᐊᐱᔑᓂᐦᑖᐅᒋᐦᒡ ᒑᒀᓐ ᐲᐦᑎᐎᔮᐦᒡ, ᒧᔮᒻ ᐊᓂᑖᐦ ᒋᑎᒋᔒᐦᒡ, ᒋᐐᔪᐦᒡ, ᐅᔅᐹᐦᒡ, ᒋᑯᐦᑖᑭᓈᐲᐦᒡ ᑭᔮᐦ ᒫᒃ ᒋᔅᑯᑎᐦᒡ
TermTranslation.public_note_en: a small growth on the lining, such as on the colon, bladder, uterus, vocal chords or nose

TermTranslation.term: e apishinihtâuchihch chekwân, mwehch aniteh e sâmitachiseyâch chitachishîhch, chiwînûhch, uspayûhch, chikuhtâkanâpîhch nesht chiskutihch
TermTranslation.term_syllabics: ᐁ ᐊᐱᔑᓂᐦᑖᐅᒋᐦᒡ ᒉᒀᓐ, ᒬᐦᒡ ᐊᓂᑌᐦ ᐁ ᓵᒥᑕᒋᓭᔮᒡ ᒋᑕᒋᔒᐦᒡ, ᒋᐐᓅᐦᒡ, ᐅᔅᐸᔫᐦᒡ, ᒋᑯᐦᑖᑲᓀᔮᐲᐦᒡ ᓀᔥᑦ ᒋᔅᑯᑎᐦᒡ
TermTranslation.public_note_en: a small growth, such as on the inner lining of the colon, bladder, uterus, vocal chords or nose
